title: Grades router (F-004)
scope: APIRouter(prefix='/grades', tags=['grades']) with GET / POST / PATCH /{grade_id} / DELETE /{grade_id}. POST surfaces 409 (ConflictError or IntegrityError mapped by errors.py) on duplicate grade_code.

success_criteria.manual: POST same grade_code twice -> first 201, second 409.
success_criteria.definition_of_done: Router delegates fully to GradeService; mapping to 409 happens via global error handlers (T-008).
